Full summary: Stage 5 (D5): keyset cursor on the triage open bucket — open_after input, open_cursor output, skip-free under concurrent drain; TRIAGE-SPEC §4.1/§11.7 updated (revisit trigger fired on the field's 320-item lane)
Decisions: Chose the spec-pre-approved keyset cursor over raising or removing the 200 cap — an uncapped response defeats the read-model's bounded-payload purpose and merely moves the cliff; keyset on the contractual (timestamp,id) sort key is skip-free under concurrent lane drain, which offset is not; Chose to keep counts.open.total as the FULL-lane total on every page rather than the post-cursor remainder — pages must be summable against a stable denominator, and the spec already designates counts as pre-truncation
